Summed-score conversion table

Source: R/bank.R
score_table.Rd

Uses the Lord-Wingersky recursion to give, for every possible summed score, the EAP trait estimate, its posterior SD and the model-implied proportion of examinees obtaining that score. This is the usual way to report IRT scores for tests scored by number-correct.

Usage

score_table(x)

Arguments

x

An `irtfit` (unidimensional) or `irt_bank`.

Value

A data frame with columns `score`, `theta`, `se` and `expected_prop`.

Examples

fit <- irt_fit(sim_irt(500, 10, "2pl"), "2pl", se = "none")
score_table(fit)
#>    score       theta        se expected_prop
#> 1      0 -2.20825097 0.6312630   0.003884347
#> 2      1 -1.83935091 0.5979120   0.020561424
#> 3      2 -1.44580116 0.5695267   0.045727659
#> 4      3 -1.07824265 0.5504095   0.075742403
#> 5      4 -0.73084957 0.5419623   0.106963527
#> 6      5 -0.39044605 0.5436246   0.135351553
#> 7      6 -0.04537354 0.5546451   0.156344240
#> 8      7  0.31391474 0.5747566   0.163485468
#> 9      8  0.69551810 0.6038679   0.147672169
#> 10     9  1.10595434 0.6417831   0.102460306
#> 11    10  1.55354997 0.6871522   0.041806903
